name: Standard Agency Due Diligence
description: Default checklist for agency acquisitions. Items can be added, removed, or modified per deal.

items.name: Tax Returns (3 years)
items.description: Federal and state tax returns for the past 3 fiscal years

items.name: Profit & Loss Statements (3 years)
items.description: Annual P&L statements for the past 3 years

items.name: Year-to-Date P&L
items.description: Current year profit & loss through most recent month

items.name: Balance Sheet (Current)
items.description: Most recent balance sheet

items.name: Accounts Receivable Aging
items.description: Current AR aging report showing outstanding invoices

items.name: Accounts Payable Aging
items.description: Current AP aging report showing outstanding bills

items.name: Bank Statements (12 months)
items.description: All business bank account statements for past 12 months

items.name: Revenue by Client
items.description: Breakdown of revenue by client for past 12-24 months

items.name: Revenue by Service Line
items.description: Breakdown of revenue by service offering

items.name: MRR Analysis
items.description: Monthly recurring revenue trends and breakdown

items.name: Entity Formation Documents
items.description: Articles of incorporation, operating agreement, bylaws, etc.

items.name: Ownership Documentation
items.description: Stock certificates, cap table, or membership interest records

items.name: DBA / Trade Name Registrations
items.description: Any 'doing business as' filings

items.name: Business Licenses
items.description: Current business licenses and permits

items.name: Litigation History
items.description: Summary of any past, pending, or threatened litigation

items.name: Trademark / IP Documentation
items.description: Trademark registrations, copyrights, patents if any

items.name: Standard NDA / Confidentiality Agreements
items.description: Templates used with clients and vendors

items.name: Employee Roster
items.description: List of all employees with titles, start dates, and locations

items.name: Compensation Details
items.description: Salary/wage information for all employees

items.name: Benefits Summary
items.description: Overview of health insurance, 401k, PTO, and other benefits

items.name: Employment Agreements
items.description: Offer letters, employment contracts, non-competes

items.name: Contractor Agreements
items.description: Agreements with regular contractors/freelancers

items.name: Employee Handbook
items.description: Current employee handbook or policies document

items.name: Organizational Chart
items.description: Visual representation of company structure

items.name: Payroll Reports (12 months)
items.description: Payroll summaries for the past 12 months

items.name: Client List
items.description: Complete list of active clients with contact info

items.name: Client Contracts / MSAs
items.description: Master service agreements and contracts for top clients

items.name: Client Tenure Report
items.description: List showing how long each client has been with the agency

items.name: Client Concentration Analysis
items.description: Revenue breakdown showing concentration percentages

items.name: Client Churn History
items.description: Lost clients over past 24 months with reasons

items.name: Pending Proposals / Pipeline
items.description: Active proposals and sales pipeline

items.name: Case Studies / Portfolio
items.description: Examples of client work and results

items.name: Technology Stack Inventory
items.description: List of all software, tools, and subscriptions with costs

items.name: SOPs / Process Documentation
items.description: Standard operating procedures for key processes

items.name: Vendor List
items.description: List of key vendors and service providers

items.name: Key Vendor Contracts
items.description: Contracts with significant vendors (hosting, tools, white-label partners)

items.name: Office Lease / Real Estate
items.description: Office lease agreement if applicable

items.name: Equipment / Asset List
items.description: Inventory of computers, equipment, and physical assets

items.name: E&O / Professional Liability Insurance
items.description: Errors & omissions insurance policy

items.name: General Liability Insurance
items.description: General liability insurance policy

items.name: Cyber Liability Insurance
items.description: Cyber liability / data breach insurance if applicable

items.name: Workers Compensation
items.description: Workers comp policy if applicable

items.name: Insurance Claims History
items.description: Record of any insurance claims filed
